args.prompt:
Create ONE completely NEW whole image of the Colosseum surviving HALF OUTER WALL, using the attached old image only as a reference for the sepia palette, matte low-poly finish, half-ellipse silhouette, and high three-quarter orthographic camera. Reconstruct the architecture from scratch. The reference has an ERROR: only TWO rows of arches. The new image MUST instead have THREE distinct vertically stacked rows of round arches, PLUS a fourth solid attic storey ABOVE all three arcade rows.

The front-facing central part of this single curved wall must show FOUR successive architectural levels, counted from the bottom upward:
1. GROUND STOREY: a row of tall open round arches reaching the bottom edge.
2. SECOND STOREY: another complete row of open round arches, directly above the ground arches, separated by a narrow horizontal cornice.
3. THIRD STOREY: a THIRD complete row of open round arches, directly above the second arches, with its own separate cornice. This is the missing storey: it must be visibly present and must not merge with the other two.
4. ATTIC: a solid upper wall band above the THIRD row, with a few small rectangular windows and shallow pilasters. The attic is NOT one of the three arch rows.
Each of the three arched storeys must have substantial similar height. At the broad center of the facade a vertical stack must visibly contain THREE rounded openings, then the solid attic. No numbers or labels in the artwork. The three rows belong to this ONE exterior facade, not inner or distant walls.

Keep the same wide low semi-elliptical shape, viewed from outside and above, open towards the back. Only approximately half of the oval outer perimeter survives. Both ends terminate in broken stepped masonry: descending irregular broad architectural steps towards the two open ends, not identical smooth vertical cuts. The long middle portion retains all THREE arcade levels and attic intact. Give the wall enough vertical room to make all four storeys unambiguous. Keep its elliptical width substantially greater than its wall height, like the real Colosseum. No complete oval, no missing-half lower rim, no seating tiers, no arena floor or disc, no interior ring, no ground or base slab.

Style exactly as the reference: clean simplified matte low-poly architectural game-map landmark, restrained pale sand, tan, warm ochre and deep brown self-shading, broad plain surfaces. No photographic texture, stone grain, artificial surface pattern, moss, shiny finish, or tiny rubble. Soft diffuse light. Same elevated three-quarter orthographic angle and similar scale/composition. Whole object fits with comfortable margins in a square canvas. Uniform very pale warm ivory background, also visible inside the open half-ellipse and through open arches. No ground plane, cast ground shadow, ambient halo, horizon, text, watermark or other object. Output a single finished square PNG, preferably 1536x1536.

Before finishing, verify the center of the visible facade has THREE rounded arch openings stacked one above another and a FOURTH solid attic above them. A two-row facade is incorrect. Preserve three arcade tiers even if this requires slightly more wall height than the flawed reference.
